resources.string: Closes Instagram Reels when they open. Reel Block watches only Instagram and reads only its screen IDs, never your messages or posts. It has no internet permission, keeps no logs and sends no data.
Closes Instagram Reels. Your feed, Stories and DMs keep working.
When the Reels viewer opens in Instagram, Reel Block presses Back for you.
Turn it on in Accessibility settings. It takes about 20 seconds.
Tap the button above, then find \"Reel Block\". It can be under \"Downloaded apps\".
Turn it on and tap Allow.
Open Instagram. When Reels opens, it closes. The rest of Instagram works as before.
Android blocks this setting for apps installed outside the Play Store. Open App info, tap ⋮ → \"Allow restricted settings\", then try again.
This phone stops Reel Block when you clear Recents. Turn on Autostart for Reel Block, and the phone starts it again in about 1 second.
No internet permission. Nothing can leave your phone.
No logs, analytics, ads or accounts.
Watches only Instagram. Reads only screen IDs, never your messages, posts or photos.
Reel Block closed %1$d Instagram Reels for me.
It\'s a free, open-source Android app that closes Instagram Reels and keeps the rest of Instagram. %1$s
